title: QubicHearts
description: A resource pack that replaces hearts (& armor, hunger, air) with squares.
body:
This is my **first** resource pack!

![Approximate appearance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/deefc27b8f14b304cfe917a702177f6da5128943.png)

Completely changes appearance of all types of hearts, as well as hunger, air, hotbar selection icon, armor, and xp-bar.
